meta.name: walmart-keyword-search
meta.description: Walmart keyword search scraper: input a search keyword and page number, navigate to walmart.com search results, extract paginated product listings with itemId, url, title, brand, image, price, wasPrice, rating, reviewCount, availability, seller info, fulfillmentBadge, classType, and shortDescription. Use when user mentions walmart search, walmart keyword search, search walmart products, scrape walmart search results, walmart search scraper, walmart product search, search items on walmart, walmart search by keyword, walmart product listing, get walmart search data, extract walmart products, walmart search results scraper, walmart shop search, walmart catalog search, walmart product list by keyword, walmart browse by keyword. Also applies to price comparison research on walmart, finding walmart product URLs in bulk, monitoring walmart search rankings, collecting walmart product data by category keyword.

copy.tagline: 按关键词抓取沃尔玛商品列表与详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取沃尔玛搜索结果中的商品信息。
copy.tagline_en: Scrape Walmart product listings by keyword search
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract Walmart search results in bulk.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的关键词和页码，自动打开沃尔玛网站搜索页，提取商品列表，包括商品ID、标题、价格、评分、库存等信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“沃尔玛搜索”、“沃尔玛关键词搜索”、“搜索沃尔玛商品”等关键词，或要求进行沃尔玛价格对比、批量查找商品URL、监控搜索排名时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索沃尔玛上“laptop”第1页的商品。
say.note: Claude 会提取该页商品列表。

say.text: 搜索沃尔玛“running shoes”按价格从低到高排序。
say.note: Claude 会按价格排序提取商品。

say.text: 提取沃尔玛“iphone”前3页的所有商品。
say.note: Claude 会逐页提取并汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open Walmart search results page based on your keyword and page number, extract product listings including itemId, title, price, rating, stock status, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like 'Walmart search', 'Walmart keyword search', 'search Walmart products', or ask for price comparison, bulk URL finding, or ranking monitoring on Walmart.

say_en.note: Claude will extract the product list.

say_en.text: Search Walmart for 'running shoes' sorted by price low to high.
say_en.note: Claude will extract products with price sort.

say_en.text: Extract all products for 'iphone' on first 3 pages.
